directions.name: Coal & Salt
directions.style_block: Ragged soot-black dry-brush contours, broken chalk-salt paint fills, two-value masses, rough hatching only at worn edges. Hooked asymmetric cloth silhouettes. Ash umber, muted slate, salt ivory, dull bronze and restrained elemental accents. Chipped timber and stone, frayed cloth. Defiant martial grit, quiet low-detail ground; no cartoon proportions.

directions.name: Cinder Veil
directions.silhouette: heavy cowls and long split mantles
directions.style_block: Dark smoky oil paint, visible hog-bristle marks, scraped impasto on highlights, lost-and-found shadow edges, no uniform outline. Weighted cowl silhouettes. Coal plum, burnt umber, warm ash, pale bone cloth and restrained elemental lights. Battered blackened bronze, cloudy glass, charred wood, slag-like wardstones. Ominous furnace dusk, quiet dark ash ground.

directions.name: Flint Litany
directions.silhouette: sawtooth shoulder wraps and triangular hems
directions.style_block: Opaque gouache, palette-knife chips, angular broken edges, three interlocking value planes. Sharp diagonal cloth and triangular silhouettes. Basalt grey, dirty ochre, dusty violet, warm ivory and restrained elemental accents. Split mineral staffs, dented angular shields, wedge wardstones and jagged rune cuts. Hard mineral light, broad matte low-detail ground.

directions.name: Verdigris Covenant
directions.shading: transparent umber glazes over dark hatch
directions.silhouette: narrow tall cowls and crescent shoulder folds
directions.style_block: Frayed etched strokes under translucent umber and malachite paint glazes, broken hatching only in shadows, broad pale cloth masses. Narrow cowl and crescent-fold silhouettes. Bottle green, dark umber, muted copper, pale linen and restrained elemental accents. Weathered spiral timber, oxidized bronze, pitted stone. Ancient storm ritual, quiet ground with sparse etched cracks.

directions.name: Ragged Oracle
directions.line: torn painted edges and charcoal seams
directions.shading: layered opaque pigment with coarse fibre
directions.silhouette: offset wrapped cowls and pennant-like split cloth
directions.style_block: Painted mixed media with torn pigment edges, charcoal seams, coarse fibre impressions and patched colour masses fused into a spatially convincing world. Asymmetric wrapped cowls and diagonal cloth silhouettes. Dirty indigo, clay, soot, faded cream, warm brass and restrained elemental accents. Frayed textile, crooked driftwood, laced shields, cracked wrapped wardstones. Resourceful wild magic, quiet rubbed ground.

directions.name: Moonchalk Tempest
directions.line: smudged charcoal and jagged chalk strokes
directions.shading: velvet dark masses with powdery highlights
directions.silhouette: wind-bent long cowls and broad bell sleeves
directions.style_block: Smudged charcoal and thick chalk-pastel strokes over velvety blue-black paint. Deep shadow masses, powdery scumbled highlights, jagged luminous edges, visible hand pressure. Sweeping wind-bent cloth silhouettes. Storm indigo, cold charcoal, grey-lilac, pale linen and restrained elemental accents. Split wood, dull silver, black fractured wardstones. Electric night squall, quiet rubbed charcoal ground.
